title: Plan execution
summary: Cleanup heartbeat losses stay in the capture and cannot block case submission. A lost completion or review-submit reply retries the same request ID against the durable ledger, without pausing a saved verdict. Other lost submission replies save the request and payload as outcome_unknown; preserve them and ask the control-plane operator to inspect the cursor. No command replays an unrecorded submission. Resume a live execution by ID to reprint its pending review bundle without recapturing. The recorded verdict batch clears the review wake. Read yoke qa plan partitions with the subject flags before a new run. Each partition contains one case chain on one target. Independent partitions can run in separate sessions, while their QA_HOST leases serialize turns on the same machine. An after_case_key names an earlier case whose partition must pass. An inherit case keeps its predecessor's machine state. Item partitions report the holder's frozen lane; with a free walk partition the holder's read first records the lane checkout's actual HEAD; the holder runs local command cases with yoke qa case run. A delegated walker uses the launch's partition key and the frozen branch and commit. A live roster takes corrections only at cases the walk has not reached; the runner's check-in compares the roster digest and stops with qa_roster_corrected when it moved, and re-running the same command resumes on the corrected roster. Current passing evidence settles a partition on its frozen target. An abandoned capture can be replaced after cleanup; an execution with pending review retains custody of the capture. Cases a stopped execution's pending review holds stay out of the roster. When nothing is owed the run refuses with qa_plan_nothing_owed and lists the stage's blockers with their next commands instead of replaying the roster; once every case passed, stage acceptance settles against the newest stopped execution. Mission capture opens walking while any mission lacks its durable walk-end receipt; the final receipt enters awaiting_walk_review atomically. Ordinary captures enter awaiting_walk_review directly. Both states retain existing review authority and mission custody; completion alone is not a QA verdict. A single agent_mission requirement starts through yoke qa case run in a one-requirement plan execution with the same lease, walker, review bundle and main-agent verdict; sibling obligations stay untouched. A held partition refuses qa_partition_unavailable and names its execution and session. Delegation lapses when the requester loses the claim; the walker may abort its own execution. An inherit mission requires its ordered predecessor and refuses single-case execution. Execution-facing recovery, review and mission commands resolve the current owner from the execution ID. Fresh item/stage starts use completion membership, while initial run-level dispatch retains its internal run/stage context. Takeover preserves all QA scopes and states without restarting a walk; inherited browser evidence may observe different builds at the same authorized environment, while command checkouts retain admitted source context. A launcher can abort the execution of the worker its launch registered, through the runner's stop and cleanup path. A launched QA worker ending with live work or without its result sends its launcher the execution subject and recovery command. A fresh walk requires a registered itemless qa-walk launch. Owners may resume their live execution. A launched walker reports the terminal execution to the current item holder or launching session.
